testsuite.name: com.slotting.admin.gameprovider.AviatorCrossRepoCertificationContractTest

testcase.name: Bet limits endpoint returns schemaVersion 1 required by Android parser
Bootstrap returns exact schemaVersion 1, rules 1.0.0, protocol 1.2.0, and bet limits
Lost response recovery via /api/command-result returns exact original ACK without double charge
POST /api/my-info returns player bets history and GET /api/get-day-history returns top multipliers
PLACE_BET using Android request body with nested accountMoney successfully reserves wager
GET /api/snapshot accepts both ?round_id and ?roundId and returns complete DTO for Android parser
Replay with same commandId but altered amount fails with 409 CONFLICT
Malformed JSON fails closed with 400 Bad Request
Bet placed when round has advanced to FLYING phase is rejected without deducting balance
CANCEL_BET omits amount and refunds authoritative wager exactly
Duplicate command returns cached ACK without double-charging ledger
Non-INR currency in command is rejected
Unauthenticated request to command or snapshot returns 401
Server restart over preserved durable stores recovers state and prevents duplicate charges
